name: attestra-mcp

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Look up a schema by UID: its definition (field types), authority, resolver and whether it is revocable.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List registered schemas, optionally only those of one authority (NEAR account).

tools.name: well_known_schemas
tools.description: The schemas every Attestra deployment registers (agent identity, agent review, private AI check, cross-chain event, wallet link, membership) with their UIDs.

tools.name: get_attestation
tools.description: Look up an attestation by UID, with its status (active, pending, revoking, revoked, expired) and its data decoded with its schema.

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: Check whether an attestation is valid right now (exists, active, not revoked, not expired).

tools.name: list_attestations
tools.description: List attestations filtered by schema UID, attester or subject (needs the indexer).

tools.name: get_authority
tools.description: Look up an authority (issuer): metadata, kind, whether governance verified it, and its staking tier.

tools.name: get_delegates
tools.description: List the delegates (employees, agents, systems) an authority lets attest for it, with scope, expiry and uses.

tools.name: get_agent_reputation
tools.description: Know Your Agent: an AI agent's identity (owner, model, capabilities, endpoint) with identity_status (verified only when the owner registered it from the agent account or its parent account), the reviews that count (one per reviewer, none by the agent, its owner or their sub-accounts), which of them are paid (job_ref is the hash of the reviewer's payment to the agent, checked on chain), the average and paid average scores, trusted with trust_reasons, and the delegations it holds.

tools.name: prove_attestation
tools.description: Prove with a NEAR light client proof that the event creating an attestation is in a final block (checked locally: validator approvals and merkle paths).

tools.name: linked_account
tools.description: Which NEAR account a wallet on another chain is linked to (a link proven by that wallet signing on chain), or null.

caip10.description: CAIP-10 wallet id, e.g. eip155:1:0xabc... or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp:<address>

tools.name: wallet_link_message
tools.description: The exact text a wallet on another chain signs (personal_sign for eip155, an ed25519 message signature for solana) to link itself to a NEAR account with link_wallet.

account_id.description: NEAR account the wallet links to

tools.name: list_agent_keys
tools.description: The NEAR function-call access keys an account gave AI agents for the attestations contract: each key's allowed methods and gas allowance left (yoctoNEAR).

tools.name: decode_data
tools.description: Decode base64 attestation data with a schema definition.

definition.description: Schema definition, e.g. "string name, u8 level"

tools.name: compute_schema_uid
tools.description: Compute the deterministic UID a schema would get, without registering it.

tools.name: list_dao_proposals
tools.description: The newest proposals of a Sputnik DAO that issues attestations (default: the deployment DAO), each with its status, votes and the attestation it asks for, decoded. A DAO-issued attestation names the DAO as its attester.

dao.description: DAO account id, such as attestra.sputnik-v2.testnet

instructions: Attestra is the attestation protocol on NEAR. Use get_attestation or verify_attestation to check a claim, get_agent_reputation and list_agent_keys before trusting an agent, linked_account to find the NEAR account behind a wallet on another chain, and prove_attestation to prove an event is final with a light client proof. Write tools run on testnet only, are capped per day and stay within spend limits per call.
